items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: Battles and I worked together for a few years... Battles was in that band with Willy Bryant... we were just really hand in hand with him.

ctx.x: That's right. So Battle is the one that hired me for that job, and I imagine that Blanche at the time wanted to fire me one million times because I didn't know what segue meant. And you know the del segno signs and all that. And I had never played a show and Battles was very boisterous. You fire him, I'm the one that hired him, fire me too. So constant going on, couple, three months from there, playing shows and things like that is when I started to learn how to play shows. And from then on, you know, I was in…

to New York, and then's when I joined Benny Carter, and then later on after Benny Carter, I went with Willy Bryant and Battles was in that band with Willy Bryant. So in the meantime, during all that time, I've been seeing Battles, knowing him, and believe it or not, when I got this number together, 'Topsy', and mentioned it, and we had recorded, I didn't know Battles was the composer.
